_doc: CHG-ESTACK-AWR-LICENSED-001 — lot B4: AWR (last 24 h, deltas between snapshots) and ASH (last 60 min) for licensed targets. The queries declare Diagnostics Pack: the gateway only runs them where the target declares license_status.diagnostics_pack = CONFIRMED (human confirmation of the contract).

collectors.title: AWR DB time and DB CPU per snapshot interval in the last 24 hours (deltas; Diagnostics Pack)
AWR top 20 SQL by elapsed time in the last 24 hours: sql_id and metrics, never SQL text (Diagnostics Pack)
AWR top 20 non-idle wait events in the last 24 hours (deltas; Diagnostics Pack)
ASH activity of the last 60 minutes by wait class, event and sql_id (samples; Diagnostics Pack)
